text:
Hi SmartWorkers team — I’m Noor Halden, and I’m a Python-focused machine learning developer with 6 years of experience building practical NLP systems and production-ready models.

Your role stood out because it sits right at the intersection of Python, AWS, and ML/AI. I’ve worked on projects where the goal was not just to train a model, but to make it useful in a real workflow. For Brightwell Clinics, I built a LoRA-tuned Flan-T5 model that drafts visit summaries after names, dates, and IDs are masked. That work used Python, Hugging Face Transformers, Flan-T5, PEFT, and AWS, and it achieved ROUGE-L 0.41 while cutting clinician editing time by 38% in a 6-week trial.

I’ve also built a support ticket triage model for Kettlewell Support Co. using Python and scikit-learn. It classifies incoming helpdesk tickets into 14 queues and is served by FastAPI, with nightly retraining handled through a Celery worker on Redis. That system reached macro-F1 0.88, improving on the old keyword rules, and reduced median routing time from 6 hours to 4 minutes.

While my experience is strongest in Python, NLP, and machine learning, I’m comfortable working in collaborative product settings where software needs to be reliable, documented, and aligned with business needs. I’m used to working with project goals, iterating on model behavior, and building systems that can be maintained and improved over time. I’d be especially interested in contributing to smart devices work that involves ML/AI and AWS-backed services.

If helpful, I can bring a strong mix of modeling, implementation, and workflow thinking to your team. How are you currently using AWS in this role, and would I be working more on ML-enabled services or on the broader application layer as well?
